name: OrganizationUnitTypePosition
title: Position Template Line
description: One line of a unit type's position template: a job profile and how many positions every unit of this type gets.

fields.name: is_head
fields.label: Head position
fields.description: The unit's head position. At most one line, with quantity 1.

fields.name: title_pattern
fields.label: Position title pattern
fields.description: Optional. {job} = job title, {unit} = unit name, {n} = sequence. Default: '{job} {unit}' (+ ' {n}' when quantity > 1).
